from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter
import numpy as np
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a=np.asarray(im).astype(float)
# local radiolucency: difference from gaussian blur, keep negatives (darker than surroundings)
b=np.asarray(im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(35))).astype(float)
d=a-b
# map: darker than local mean -> bright
d=d*(d<0)
d=(d-d.min())/(d.max()-d.min())*255
out=Image.fromarray(d.astype('uint8'))
out=out.crop((550,350,1950,1050)).resize((2800,1400))
out.save('radiolucency.png')
print('ok')
